checkRuns.command:
sed -i '/cacheComponents/d;/partialPrefetching/d' next.config.ts
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -5; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -25
(PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/nope /zzz /contact; do curl -s -o /tmp/o -w "$p %{http_code}\n" localhost:4711$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/o; done
curl -s localhost:4711/books/dracula | grep -o '<h2.*' | head -c 300
curl -s -X POST -d 'name=Al&email=x&message=hi' localhost:4711/contact | head -c 100; echo
pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f "next-server"; true

docs.source: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt and the Markdown of the pages it links
